references.read_sections: Sections 4.2, 5.1-5.2 and Appendices B-C; equations 25-26 and B1/C1 visually inspected on original pages.
references.use: Coupled uniform-face diffusion, common-corner source condition, necessary hollowing condition, thin-ring C1.
references.convention: Implement ambient-equilibrium supersaturation and later-source density linearization explicitly; not a bitwise reproduction of the 1996 equations.

references.read_sections: Sections 3.1-3.3, particularly source positions, growth kinetics and the lacuna criterion.
references.use: Supports separation of local growth steps from uniform face flux and hollowing; no 2001 kinetic-law coefficients fitted here.
Existing source air properties, temperature-dependent critical supersaturations and mechanism convention.
references.restriction: Source getscrit explicitly sets equal basal and prism characteristics below -30 C; no independent dislocation calibration from switching m.

references.use: Pinned cylinder shape functions and laboratory series.
references.restriction: Complete 2026 growth equations remain unretrieved; this diagnostic is not that full model.

sources.rights: Original papers and archive bytes remain in the ignored local cache. Only own implementation, bibliographic metadata and derived diagnostics are tracked. No external notification sent.
model_limits: Continuum cylinder approximation, stationary diffusion formally; optional common conductance multipliers are sensitivities.
Local latent-heat geometry, no internal crystal conduction or substrate heat sink; no molecular-jump corrections.
The declared width/a <= 0.1 thin-rim range is a conservative analysis choice for the source narrow-ring asymptote, not a measured physical boundary.
No off-edge hollow field, cavity-depth state, rim evolution, finite vapor reservoir, aggregation or fracture in this component.

equation_audit.source: Nelson and Baker 1996, printed B1 versus Table B1 and pinned 2026 implementation
equation_audit.finding: Printed h_a fit labels log10; the later archived implementation uses natural log. The latter agrees with the selected original numerical table to within 5.46%; no change to the pinned 2026 source was made. This records the source discrepancy without claiming a verified author correction.

The basal contribution subtracts h_c(phi/x) with the same c normalization. No additional factor x multiplies that contribution. Visually checked against the original page; applicability remains asymptotic for x near one.

patches: Remove exactly two unused scratio_a/c assignments reading uninitialized scrat_low/hi.
Extract routines after the published main program for the shared library.
Replace only spheroid capacitance arithmetic with equivalent factored eccentricity/asin and asinh forms.
attachment_build.wrapper: C-double interface converts inputs to native REAL; original coefficient operations unchanged.
source_limits: Characteristic-supersaturation fits guarded to -70 through -1 C; m in [1,15].
Native coefficients have an existing floor of 1e-6.
No ventilation input; assumes source air transport properties.
Source metadata requires annual notification of customization; no notification sent.
attachment_build.evidence: Compiled published component; native demo is a numerical reference, not empirical validation.

changes: No numerical changes to original fitting routines.
Extract routines after native main program for local C interface.
Second demo changes only the published iwd parameter from zero to one.
geometry_build.evidence: Numerical geometry component only; no attachment, thermal or hollow-rim evolution solver.

limits: Fitted derivatives are not directly measured instantaneous rates; no fitted-derivative error bars exist.
The cylinder transport approximation is explicit; mass-budget geometry uses the laboratory hexagonal envelope separately.
Uniform-face failure is diagnosed at edges and centres, not every point; passing these necessary conditions is insufficient validation.
Changing m with unchanged critical supersaturation is a sensitivity, not a calibrated dislocation model.
JW is a supplied common vapor/heat conductance factor using source Sc=0.63, not a resolved faceted flow field.
Thin basal rims use NB96 C1 only at the common corner; their off-edge field, hollow volume and rim evolution are unavailable.

cold_constraints.source: Pinned 2021 getscrit explicitly sets sa=sc below -30 C.
cold_constraints.invariant: With identical mechanisms and characteristics at a common corner, da=dc for every size, humidity and common transport multiplier, including the prescribed thin-basal-rim approximation.
limits: This excludes the inherited equal-face/common-corner hypothesis for the resolved windows, not the original 2021 spheroidal solver with separate surface humidities.
Substrate experiments can alter step sources and heat flow; they do not directly validate free-falling crystals.
Reported error bounds exclude measurement perturbations only; forcing/systematic errors are not quantified.

evidence: Source-based continuum falsification and prescribed-rim sensitivities; no autonomous Earth calibration or adopted lunar snow distribution.
